prediction_scope: Fixed new shared neighbors never sampled in the full 13-row history of any of these replacement backends: legacy_role_full, legacy_role_after_init_point_only, legacy_role_point_only, same_source_gp, current_structural_mixture. Native is outside this intersection. Saved prefix10 to prefix12 spans two adaptive observations; prefix13 predictions are not reconstructed. Tasks are primary units; policy-weighted errors are descriptive.
intervention_scope: The point-only intervention starts at the first initialization raw and disables cross-policy updates in the replacement decision posterior. The original proposal frontend still learns from each arm's own paid raw; this does not disable frontend propagation. The after-init point-only control first conditions jointly on all ten initialization observations, identically to full. Subsequent observations update only their own physical policy in the decision posterior; unobserved marginals remain at this shared initialization posterior. Its original proposal frontend continues learning from its own paid raw.
